{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check number of unique patients
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many duplicates (by patient_id)
duplicates = df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicates.sum()}")

# Check for any patient_id with more than one row
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(dup_patients)}")
print(f"Patient IDs with multiple rows: {list(dup_patients.index)}")

# Show the max sample_seq per patient
max_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient (first 5):\n{max_seq_per_patient.head(5)}")"}
